arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site')
import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/native/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import harness; harness.setup_env()
import gen2, formats, pipeline, reference
norm = lambda o: json.dumps(o, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
stats=collections.Counter(); bad=0
for seed in range(120):
    request = gen2.make_request(seed)
    try:
        mine = pipeline.execute(formats.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(request))))
    except Exception as e:
        print('exc', seed, repr(e)); continue
    theirs = reference.execute(request)
    if norm(mine)!=norm(theirs):
        bad+=1; print('SEED',seed,'diff')
    for cat in mine['catalog']:
        stats['clusters']+=len(cat['clusters'])
        stats['kept']+=len(cat['priority'])
        stats['noise']+=len(cat['noise'])
        stats['frag']+=len(cat['fragments'])
        stats['entries']+=cat['entries']
        for cl in cat['clusters']:
            stats['spread-%d'%min(9,max(hi-lo for lo,hi in cl['range']))]+=1
    for d in mine['decisions']: stats['dec-'+d['reason']]+=1
    for i in mine['installs']: stats['ins-'+i['status']]+=1
print('bad',bad); print(dict(stats))
PYEOF
